info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Syndication Management API
info.description: The Loan Syndication Management API facilitates modifications to loan syndication agreements, allowing institutions to efficiently adjust terms and details as needed. Users can update various parameters associated with existing loan syndication contracts, enhancing operational flexibility and accuracy. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions and lenders managing multiple syndicate loans, enabling them to respond promptly to changing market conditions or client requirements. Typical consumers include loan officers and back-office staff involved in loan servicing and management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that all required fields for updating the loan information are included. The data should be formatted as per the defined schema for proper validation.
